recommendation: Keep the core audit commit and pursue the actual display correction in THO/terminology source for CodeSystem-consentpolicycodes so future core builds consume the corrected display.
issue_request: FHIR-17168 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CBCC correction requesting that consent policy code va-10-10116 display as VA Form 10-10116 rather than VA Form 10-10-10116.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit for FHIR-17168 was found. The former core CodeSystem source still had the incorrect display immediately before the 2020 UTG-content removal, and remaining tools/history release and expansion files show the typo only as checked-in generated history.
additional_context: The current core source keeps source/consent/valueset-consent-policy.xml in the active Consent area, but that ValueSet includes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/consentpolicycodes and the local checkout has no current consentpolicycodes CodeSystem source. Fetching terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem-consentpolicycodes JSON shows va-10-10116 still displays as VA Form 10-10-10116, so the unresolved authoritative content is external terminology content.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because current core does not own the affected CodeSystem concept and editing generated historical artifacts would not change the current build source of truth.
